command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
Write-Host ("HEAD="+(& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim())
Write-Host ("BRANCH="+(& git branch --show-current).Trim())
Write-Host ("ORIGIN_MAIN="+(& git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main).Trim())
Write-Host "STATUS_BEGIN"
& git status --short
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "git status failed"}
Write-Host "STATUS_END"
